lines.trans: This is assistant director Baek Seung-chan from 2 Days and 1 Night.
You remember the umbrella I lent you last time, right?
Right on cue, I knew he asked for my number to make a move like this.
I noticed you have not returned the umbrella yet.
I reminded you several times because I was afraid this might happen.
Please return it as soon as possible.
Just give my name and return it to the annex lobby by nine tomorrow morning.
For every day it is late, a late fee comes straight out of my salary.
Please be sure to return it.
No way, is his business with me seriously nothing but the umbrella?
